task.goal: Delete the following expenses from pro expense: Utilities, Dining Out, Specialty Foods.
task.final_summary: I deleted all three expenses from Pro Expense: Utilities ($135.26, Oct 4), Dining Out ($323.16, Oct 3) and Specialty Foods ($230.87, Oct 11). Each was removed through its row's swipe-to-reveal Delete with confirmation, and a full recount of Expense Logs now shows 50 entries, down from 53, with none of those three titles present.
